scope_limits: Abstract body objects stand in for the 30,128-byte CBOR encoding; byte-level CBOR/LSP/CRC reproduction is already covered by integrated-capture-model and is not repeated here.
No core-queue messages, KV coordination, libnats ACK semantics, TLS, uploader or cloud receiver.
Publish return codes, CRC/DRDY outcomes, stop/start/reinit events are explicit inputs, not observed device behavior or fault rates.
No shared-log formatting/reentrancy, no malformed payloads, no vendor binary execution.
No physical timing: ticks are software counts, not wall-clock measurements.
